description: The six ai-save-{new-revision,approval,drop-reclaim}-{event-first,save-first} cases at patch-risk.integration.ts:278-286 finish the first transaction before initiating the competing operation. Save-first also refreshes command coordinates before the lifecycle event. Passing these sequential cases does not prove lock-wait/stale-version behavior under contention. Initiate both operations with their original captured coordinates while one holds the relevant lock, prove the second is waiting, then release and assert allowed commits/conflicts plus atomic business/activity/notification outcomes. No production race failure is established; six matrix concurrency obligations remain unresolved despite green selectors.
